schema: delay-ledger v1 — every entry: when the governor asked, when work actually started, when it finished, the execution time vs the WALL-CLOCK cost to the family, and the categorized reason for any gap. Darrell 2026-07-07: 'keep recording the time it would have taken if you did what was requested when I asked and the difference... categorize each reason for our data-driven reasons to use this model AI or that one.' Request/finish times are the report metric — not the agent's execution time.

categories.agent-self-deferral: The agent parked authorized work without the governor saying stop (P28 / DR-0115).
categories.incomplete-verification: Partial local verification let CI catch what the full suite would have caught before push.
categories.re-ask: The agent asked a question already answered instead of executing (DR-0111).
categories.premise-error: Work built on a wrong premise had to be redone.
categories.external-wait: Genuine external dependency (CI runtime, deploy, third-party).
categories.governor-hold: The governor deliberately held or re-scoped the work (never counted as unnecessary).

entries.request: Her app changes colors and resizes text like PoeTech (+ unified Admin/User door)
entries.notes: The agent had the full build map and 'we need that asap', and still parked the increment overnight citing its own session length. Execution took ~45 min once started; the family's wall-clock cost was the whole night. LESSONS 2026-07-07 / P28 / DR-0115.

Targeted tests instead of the full suite before push; CI caught two remaining monolith-readers (legibility guard themes, persistent-share ledger). Full suite is the pre-push bar for extraction-class changes.
